conditions.monochrome: explicit yellow; physical star hue is not altered in the renderer

limits: Isolated actual production renderer on black; no full-island/cloud/water/air/scene-performance acceptance

PNG is vendor ACES+sRGB at fixed C; no absolute camera or pyrotechnic photometry calibration
